$comment: Tested Alloy-Edge pairing. docs/compatibility.md is the human-readable record. edge is the contract baseline; edge_support.tested lists every release CI tests, newest first. Values here must match .github/workflows/ci.yml, examples/edge-observability/Dockerfile, docs/compatibility.md, and (collector) .github/workflows/newbenchmark-only.yml and .github/workflows/bench-gate.yml (checked by crates/ferrum-alloy-edge/tests/pairing.rs). .github/workflows/edge-bump.yml proposes new releases.

edge_support.policy: The latest Ferrum Edge release and the release before it. Older releases are unsupported.

transports.edge_to_alloy: https (h2 via ALPN) with mTLS client certificate
